location_description: The tension-clamp aluminum tube is located within the blue box and is inclined from the upper left to the lower right. Its left end is connected through the steel anchor to the connecting fitting in the upper-left area, while its right end is connected to the stranded conductor extending toward the lower right.
left_end_crimp: Yes | The portion near the steel anchor at the left end of the aluminum tube is cylindrical, with a smooth surface and rounded profile. No continuous hexagonal edges or regularly flattened section is visible.
right_end_crimp: No | A relatively long, regularly polygonal crimped section is present near the conductor at the right end of the aluminum tube. Continuous straight edges and adjacent flat surfaces are visible up to the conductor inlet, indicating distinct crimping deformation rather than brightness variation caused solely by highlights or shadows.
grade_result: Else | The left end of the aluminum tube is a smooth cylindrical area without obvious crimping marks, so the right end is subsequently inspected. A clear and continuous polygonal crimped section is present at the right end, which is not a smooth cylindrical area. This forms an uncrimped-crimped condition and is therefore graded as Else according to the decision tree.
